# `<sl-header>` — Header

> **Only in Saipem DS.** This component does not exist in upstream Shoelace or Web Awesome: use only the API below.

Headers are the brand bar at the top of an application: logo, main navigation and global actions such as the project picker and the user menu.

**Status:** experimental · **Since:** 2.20

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/header/header.js';`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nav-label` | `navLabel` | `string` | `'Main'` | The accessible name of the navigation landmark. Set it to localize the component. |
| `logo-src` | `logoSrc` | `string` | `''` | The source of a logo image to show when the `logo` slot is left empty, e.g. a product mark that doesn't need any custom markup. Ignored if the `logo` slot has content. |
| `logo-label` | `logoLabel` | `string` | `''` | An accessible label for the image set with `logo-src`. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `logo` | The logo and product name. When empty, falls back to the image set with `logo-src`. |
| (default) | The main navigation, as `<a>` elements or `<sl-header-item>` elements. Mark the current page with `aria-current="page"` (or the `current` attribute on `<sl-header-item>`). |
| `actions` | Controls shown at the trailing end, e.g. a project select, a help link and the user menu. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper, a `<header>` element. |
| `logo` | The container that wraps the logo slot. |
| `logo-image` | The fallback logo `<img>`, shown when `logo-src` is set and the `logo` slot is empty. |
| `nav` | The navigation landmark that wraps the default slot. |
| `actions` | The container that wraps the actions slot. |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--height` | — | The header's height, excluding the accent line. |
| `--background` | — | The header's background colour. |
| `--color` | — | The colour of text and icons in the header. |
| `--accent-color` | — | The colour of the line along the bottom edge. |
| `--nav-gap` | — | The spacing between main navigation items. |

## Documentation and examples

The header uses the brand petrol with the orange accent line along its bottom edge, in both light and dark themes. Put
the logo in the `logo` slot, the main navigation in the default slot and global controls in the `actions` slot.

Navigation entries are [`sl-header-item`](header-item.md) elements. Mark the current page with the `current`
attribute, or set `href` for a plain link. Give an item a `menu` slot to turn it into a dropdown.

```html
<sl-header logo-src="/assets/images/saipem-mark.png" logo-label="Saipem">
  <sl-header-item>
    Project Data
    <sl-menu slot="menu">
      <sl-menu-item>Documents</sl-menu-item>
      <sl-menu-item>Reports</sl-menu-item>
    </sl-menu>
  </sl-header-item>
  <sl-header-item>
    Configuration
    <sl-menu slot="menu">
      <sl-menu-item>Users</sl-menu-item>
      <sl-menu-item>Permissions</sl-menu-item>
    </sl-menu>
  </sl-header-item>
  <sl-header-item href="#" current>Dashboard</sl-header-item>

  <sl-select slot="actions" size="small" value="xcmm-demo" style="width: 14rem;">
    <sl-option value="xcmm-demo">xCMM Demo</sl-option>
    <sl-option value="fepco">FEPCO Project</sl-option>
  </sl-select>
  <sl-icon-button slot="actions" name="question-circle" label="Help"></sl-icon-button>
  <sl-icon-button slot="actions" name="gear" label="Settings"></sl-icon-button>
  <sl-icon-button slot="actions" name="box-arrow-right" label="Sign out"></sl-icon-button>
</sl-header>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/header/header.js';

import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-header-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <sl-header logo-src="/assets/images/saipem-mark.png" logo-label="Saipem">
      <sl-header-item>
        Project Data
        <sl-menu slot="menu">
          <sl-menu-item>Documents</sl-menu-item>
          <sl-menu-item>Reports</sl-menu-item>
        </sl-menu>
      </sl-header-item>
      <sl-header-item>
        Configuration
        <sl-menu slot="menu">
          <sl-menu-item>Users</sl-menu-item>
          <sl-menu-item>Permissions</sl-menu-item>
        </sl-menu>
      </sl-header-item>
      <sl-header-item href="#" current>Dashboard</sl-header-item>

      <sl-select slot="actions" size="small" value="xcmm-demo" style="width: 14rem;">
        <sl-option value="xcmm-demo">xCMM Demo</sl-option>
        <sl-option value="fepco">FEPCO Project</sl-option>
      </sl-select>
      <sl-icon-button slot="actions" name="question-circle" label="Help"></sl-icon-button>
      <sl-icon-button slot="actions" name="gear" label="Settings"></sl-icon-button>
      <sl-icon-button slot="actions" name="box-arrow-right" label="Sign out"></sl-icon-button>
    </sl-header>
  `
})
export class HeaderExampleComponent {}
```

## Examples

### With a logo image

Images and SVGs in the `logo` slot are sized to fit the header.

```html
<sl-header logo-src="/assets/images/saipem-mark.png" logo-label="Saipem">
  <sl-header-item href="#" current>Home</sl-header-item>
  <sl-header-item href="#">Incoming</sl-header-item>
  <sl-header-item href="#">Outgoing</sl-header-item>
</sl-header>
```

### Account menu

Put an `sl-header-item` in the `actions` slot to show the signed-in user. An `sl-avatar` in its label is sized to fit
next to the name.

```html
<sl-header logo-src="/assets/images/saipem-mark.png" logo-label="Saipem">
  <span slot="logo">DMS</span>

  <sl-header-item slot="actions">
    <sl-avatar initials="MR" label="Mario Rossi"></sl-avatar>
    Mario Rossi
    <sl-menu slot="menu">
      <sl-menu-item>Profile</sl-menu-item>
      <sl-divider></sl-divider>
      <sl-menu-item><sl-icon slot="prefix" name="box-arrow-right"></sl-icon>Sign out</sl-menu-item>
    </sl-menu>
  </sl-header-item>
</sl-header>
```

### Plain links

The default slot also accepts plain `<a>` elements, styled the same way as `sl-header-item`. Mark the current page
with `aria-current="page"`.

```html
<sl-header>
  <span slot="logo">xCMM</span>

  <a href="#" aria-current="page">Home</a>
  <a href="#">Incoming</a>
  <a href="#">Outgoing</a>
  <a href="#">Distribution History</a>
  <a href="#">Search</a>
</sl-header>
```

### Customizing

Use `--height`, `--background`, `--color` and `--accent-color` to adapt the header, e.g. for a test environment that
must not be mistaken for production.

```html
<sl-header style="--background: var(--sl-color-neutral-800); --accent-color: var(--sl-color-warning-500);">
  <span slot="logo">xCMM · UAT</span>
  <sl-header-item href="#" current>Home</sl-header-item>
  <sl-header-item href="#">Incoming</sl-header-item>
</sl-header>
```
